Model notes & data format

The featured match uses StatsBomb’s supplied expected-goals values. Extra-time shots and in-match penalties are included; the penalty shootout is excluded. The score reflects the selected shots. Outcome probabilities assume independent shots and are not forecasts. Custom imports without xg use the original untrained distance/angle/body-part heuristic.

Import a JSON array (up to 5,000 shots, 2 MB). Required fields: x (0–105 meters), y (0–68 meters), minute (0–130), team (home/away), player (text), bodyPart (foot/head/other), goal (boolean). Normalize every shot to attack the goal at x=105, y=34. Imported teams use the Home/Away labels. Optional xg must be between 0 and 1. Export this match to see an example.
